data.name: Jenn
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word ‘gifan’, meaning ‘to give’. The name Jenn refers to a gift or a gracious woman. in_hebrew.name: ג'ן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ג'ן הוא שם שמקורו באנגלית ומשמש כקיצור לשמות ש начинающих ביהו-, כמו ג'ניפר. השם ג'ניפר מקורו מהעברית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא חנון ורחום'. הוא קשור לשם העברי יו-, שמשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא חיים'. השם ג'ן משמש גם כקיצור לשמות אחרים הנגזרים מהשורש העברי יה-, כמו יוחנן.

in_greek.name: Τζέν
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι χαριτωμένος και ελεήμων
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Τζέν είναι μια σύντομη μορφή ονομάτων που αρχίζουν με Γεν-, όπως η Γενιφέρ. Το όνομα Γενιφέρ προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι χαριτωμένος και ελεήμων'. Είναι συνδεδεμένο με το εβραϊκό όνομα יו-, που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ζωή'. Το Τζέν χρησιμοποιείται επίσης ως συντομογραφία για άλλα ονόματα που προέρχονται από την εβραϊκή ρίζα יה-, όπως το Ιωάννης.

in_latin.name: Jenn
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Jenn est forma abbreviata nominum quae incipiunt a Gen-, ut Gennifera. Nomen Gennifera origine hebraea provenit et significat 'Deus est misericors et benignus'. Est coniunctum cum nomine hebraeo יו-, quod significat 'Deus est vita'. Jenn etiam adhibetur ut abbreviatio pro aliis nominibus quae derivantur ex radice hebraea יה-, ut Ioannes.

in_english.name: Jenn
in_english.meaning: God is gracious and merciful short form
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jenn is a shortened form of names beginning with Jen-, such as Jennifer. Originating from the Hebrew language, Jennifer means 'God is gracious and merciful'. It is connected to the Hebrew name יו- (Yo-), meaning 'God is life'. Jenn is also used as a short form for other names derived from the Hebrew root יה- (Yah-), like John. Historically, the name has been associated with Christian traditions and symbolizes divine favor and compassion.

In popular culture, the name Jen has been associated with characters who possess strong personalities, intelligence, and self-confidence. In this sense, the name represents a well-rounded individual who is not only self-sufficient but also cares for others.
data.spiritual_significance: As a name rooted in Old English traditions, Jenn carries spiritual significance by reminding us of God's essential nature -- a giver. His mercy and bountifulness are reflected in the name, which itself embodies the idea of giving. Furthermore, Josiah Henson, an enslaved African American who escaped to Canada and became a Methodist minister, was given the name Jean (a French form of Jenn), to reflect the goodness and compassion he embodied. This spiritual connection demonstrates the potential for the name Jenn to inspire both personal and communal growth, as a reminder to live generously and graciously, as God does.
